todo.contribute.defaultMessage: Add them to the project's stopwords
todo.contribute.description: Call to contribute under the suspected noise of the to-do page, leading to the contribution address of the project.

todo.findings.description: Number of findings listed on the to-do page.

todo.noise.description: Heading of the folded section of the to-do page listing the expressions the confidence set aside.

todo.noiseNote.defaultMessage: Frequent enough for a page, but spread like the prose of the notes rather than a term of the corpus: no page, no mark in the text, still found by the search.
todo.noiseNote.description: Sentence under the heading of the suspected noise, saying what the list holds and what those expressions lack.

todo.reasonBurst.description: Part of the reason an expression is suspected noise, its occurrences per file, under one and a half.

todo.reasonMorphology.description: Part of the reason an expression is suspected noise: a word of it ends like an inflected form of the language.

todo.reasonSpread.defaultMessage: in {share, number, percent} of the files
todo.reasonSpread.description: Part of the reason an expression is suspected noise: the share of the corpus files it appears in, beyond half.

todo.severity.error.description: Severity label of a finding that fails the build.

todo.severity.info.description: Severity label of a finding given for information only.

todo.severity.warning.description: Severity label of a finding that is reported but tolerated.

todo.showOthers.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Show the # other} other {Show the # others}}
todo.showOthers.description: Line that unfolds the words of the to-do page listed after the first hundred, with how many they are.

todo.title.description: Heading of the page listing the findings of the build.
